FRONTEND (Expo web preview): registered a fresh TEST_pwui_<ts>@esempio.it via /(auth)/register (390x844), navigated to Profilo -> profile-change-password -> /change-password: pw-submit disabled with empty fields (aria-disabled=true); mismatching confirm -> toast 'Le due password non coincidono' (matched); weak password -> toast 'La nuova password deve avere almeno 8 caratteri...' After logout, login with the old password fails, with the new password succeeds and the app opens on Home ('Analizza la mia bolletta' visible). CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG discovered on the admin entry point: the admin-change-password button navigates to /change-password but /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx:39-40 redirects any admin whose root segment is not '(admin)'/'admin'/'welcome' back to '/(admin)' - so the change-password screen never renders for admin (verified by clicking admin-change-password from Impostazioni and by direct navigation to /change-password: both bounce back to /(admin) dashboard, pw-submit never visible). The customer flow is unaffected (guard only redirects customers away from (admin)/(auth) roots).

ui_bugs.issue: Admin users are hard-redirected away from any route whose first segment is not '(admin)'/'admin'/'welcome'. This makes the /change-password screen unreachable for admin: clicking admin-change-password in Impostazioni (or direct-navigating to /change-password) immediately bounces back to /(admin). Fix: allow additional whitelisted routes (e.g. 'change-password') for admins, or move change-password under /(admin)/change-password. Reference: /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx:39-40.

action_items: Fix admin routing so /change-password renders for admins. Simplest patch: update the guard in /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx to also treat root === 'change-password' (and any other cross-role screens like /notifications if applicable) as allowed for admins, e.g.: `if (user.role === 'admin' && !['(admin)','admin','welcome','change-password'].includes(root)) router.replace('/(admin)');`. Alternatively add a /(admin)/change-password screen and point admin-change-password there.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:1218-1237 PUT /api/auth/password - correctly bumps password_version, deletes user_sessions for the user, writes admin_audit 'change_password' when user is admin, and returns a fresh JWT built with the new pv (verified: previous tokens return 401 via get_current_user's pv check at line 250).

backend/server.py:501-512 ChangePasswordInput - Pydantic returns 422 on weak new_password (length + upper/lower/digit + 72-byte cap) before entering the handler; same-as-current and no-password (social) mapped to 400 (verified).

backend/server.py:1401-1417 admin seed on startup is idempotent (insert only if missing, otherwise only role is refreshed) - so a UI-driven admin password change would persist across restarts. Confirmed by code review, not exercised at runtime.

frontend/app/change-password.tsx - client-side validation (mismatch, strong regex, same-as-current) surfaces via toast BEFORE calling PUT /auth/password; fresh token saved via setToken then router.back(); for social accounts renders explanatory copy instead of the form (guarded by user.auth_provider).

rca_of_issue: RCA of admin unreachable change-password: /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx RootNavigator has `if (user.role === 'admin') { if (root !== '(admin)' && root !== 'admin' && root !== 'welcome') router.replace('/(admin)') }`. Since /change-password is a top-level route (root segment 'change-password'), the effect fires on every render for admins and replaces the URL back to /(admin), so the screen mounts for a frame and unmounts immediately. Reproduction: login as admin, open /(admin)/impostazioni, tap admin-change-password (or navigate directly to /change-password) - URL becomes /(admin) and the pw-submit testID is never visible. Mitigation: whitelist 'change-password' (and any other shared screens) in that admin guard, or duplicate the screen under /(admin)/change-password and point the admin button there. Backend and customer paths are unaffected.
